science_recipe.question: Does the accepted original zero-start physical field supply full-TET10 native P2 U/physical gradient and a bounded physical-coordinate query interface on these five known CAD/ver inputs?
science_recipe.comparison_scope: Independent capability evidence, not repair of signed-S pair and not causal architecture ranking against pointcloud-only neural routes.

full_cell_scope.ordered_queries: original cell row then accepted fourQ index, every original cell, no sampling

science_recipe.quadrature: a=(5+3sqrt(5))/20; b=(5-sqrt(5))/20; four ordered (a,b,b,b) permutations; use accepted physical positive weights/gradients directly

native_field_math.U: U_cq,a=sum_i N_i(Lq) U_cell_i,a; all signed10 P2 weights, no P1 corner surrogate
native_field_math.X: X_cq=sum_i N_i(Lq) X_cell_i, curved physical TET10 geometry
native_field_math.gradient: G_cq,a,b=sum_i U_cell_i,a * accepted_dN_dX_cq,i,b; no new operator assembly or solve
native_field_math.additional_queries: J_c,r=sum_i X_i,c dN_i/dr_r; solve J^T grad_X_N=grad_r_N in FP64, then same full10 U/G. No normalized-coordinate derivative.

science_recipe.GT_proxy: Only original canonical nodal displacement member, after all five candidate predictions commit. Apply same10 P2 basis and physical gradients to GT U. Derived U/G/engineering-strain are node-derived P2 proxies, never source-solver strain GT, constitutive recovery or continuum validation.

candidate_persistence_before_GT.resume: Never recompute committed candidate queries or repeat committed source GT U reads; use owned per-case derived proxy/metric cache. Uncommitted GT read remains explicit blocking failure.

metrics.primary: Each CAD full4Q positive-volume-weighted U-vector/G-Frobenius/engineering6 relativeL2, reference energy zero => null, no epsilon-manufactured score
metrics.absolute: weighted U-vector RMS mm and maximum vector error mm; G-Frobenius and strain6 RMS/max dimensionless
metrics.physical_strain_tensor: Also report symmetric3x3 Frobenius proxy error; engineering6 norm weights [1,1,1,0.5,0.5,0.5], not a six-component energy equivalence claim
metrics.aggregate: fixed denominator5, per-case and worst/mean; do not transfer existing node U error to new4Q scores

small_query_scope.selection: one actual scan_face_conformity per CAD max_records8; select_cells_and_faces max_cells32/max_faces8, lexicographic corner-ID face order plus original cell rows; no result-driven selection
small_query_scope.interior: two strictly interior barycentrics [0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4] and [0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1] per selected cell, <=64 occurrences/CAD
small_query_scope.shared_faces: two canonical-face barycentrics [1/3,1/3,1/3] and [0.2,0.3,0.5], map sorted shared corner IDs onto both local cells; <=16 shared physical points/32 sided occurrences/CAD
small_query_scope.C0: record physical-position and U trace differences; no GT needed to establish same conforming6-node quadratic face trace
small_query_scope.normal_derivative: report (G_left-G_right) n using one common unit normal from canonical shared P2 surface tangents; one-sided derivatives, expected nonzero for C0 FE, never a C1 failure gate
small_query_scope.inverse: reuse bounded GeometryLocator.locate on selected<=32 cells for the <=96 occurrences, no oracle barycentrics supplied to inverse; inherited LocatorConfig bounds unchanged
small_query_scope.scope_limit: All-cell barycentric/native queries plus bounded physical-point inversion; no claim of a fast unlabelled-point global whole-CAD locator or globally unique inverse.

acceptance.capability_complete: all5 all4Q predicted+GT-proxy metrics finite and covered, exact row/element identities, positive accepted weights, FP64 mm units, all5 prelabel barrier, no forbidden reads
acceptance.new_small_geometry: only the actual selected query validity/inverse checks; failure reported without repair/substitution; no old8K guards repeated
acceptance.accuracy: Report fixed fullQ proxy accuracy separately from native API/coverage acceptance; no source strain accuracy or final solver winner inferred.
acceptance.trace_tolerance_definitions: max physical position trace gap / characteristic L <=1e-9; max U trace gap / max(1mm,max absolute traceU) <=1e-9; inverse/direct U replay uses same1mm floor with1e-7 tolerance. These are numerical replay gates, not GT accuracy denominators.
acceptance.zero_reference: A zero GT proxy energy yields null relative score plus exact zero flag and absolute error; this does not mean missing coverage.

read_policy.accepted_cache_members: vertices_mm,cells10,grid_node_ids,ctetra_element_ids; accepted gradients/weights. Reuse load_input target-free reader if necessary, no scientific old stage entrypoint.

budget.one_fixed_attempt: No new solve/recovery/tuning/mesh fallback. Actual first frozen run is acceptance; no resource or science preflight. Failure/resume wall counts without reset.
budget.costs: Cached continuous query/input/reference/persistence costs measured separately; full service cost composes original zero physics plus actual continuous query costs, not a fresh combined cold measurement. Never splice newer fine/coarse costs.
budget.ledger: Compact case/phase/elapsed journal about60s or completeCAD/barrier/failure; deterministic selectors+cursor replace unbounded prefixes. Final exit always accounts wall, failed attempts and unfinished work.

reuse_API.topology_and_inverse: same scan_face_conformity/select_cells_and_faces/GeometryLocator.locate; no synthetic_fixture or old101479 evaluator
reuse_API.target_free_cache: geobc.elastic_pilot_data.load_input; metadata contract/stat helpers from elastic_crosscad; direct selective accepted cache reads may avoid unused RBE/load data
reuse_API.engineering_note: Do not reuse corner-P1 gradient_supervision.cell_tensor_strain or call old bounded diagnostic scientific entrypoints

full_cell_scope.ordered_queries: original cell row then accepted fourQ index, every original cell, no sampling

science_recipe.quadrature: a=(5+3sqrt(5))/20; b=(5-sqrt(5))/20; four ordered (a,b,b,b) permutations; use accepted physical positive weights/gradients directly

native_field_math.U: U_cq,a=sum_i N_i(Lq) U_cell_i,a; all signed10 P2 weights, no P1 corner surrogate
native_field_math.X: X_cq=sum_i N_i(Lq) X_cell_i, curved physical TET10 geometry
native_field_math.gradient: G_cq,a,b=sum_i U_cell_i,a * accepted_dN_dX_cq,i,b; no new operator assembly or solve
native_field_math.additional_queries: J_c,r=sum_i X_i,c dN_i/dr_r; solve J^T grad_X_N=grad_r_N in FP64, then same full10 U/G. No normalized-coordinate derivative.

science_recipe.GT_proxy: Only original canonical nodal displacement member, after all five candidate predictions commit. Apply same10 P2 basis and physical gradients to GT U. Derived U/G/engineering-strain are node-derived P2 proxies, never source-solver strain GT, constitutive recovery or continuum validation.

candidate_persistence_before_GT.resume: Never recompute committed candidate queries or repeat committed source GT U reads; use owned per-case derived proxy/metric cache. Uncommitted GT read remains explicit blocking failure.

metrics.primary: Each CAD full4Q positive-volume-weighted U-vector/G-Frobenius/engineering6 relativeL2, reference energy zero => null, no epsilon-manufactured score
metrics.absolute: weighted U-vector RMS mm and maximum vector error mm; G-Frobenius and strain6 RMS/max dimensionless
metrics.physical_strain_tensor: Also report symmetric3x3 Frobenius proxy error; engineering6 norm weights [1,1,1,0.5,0.5,0.5], not a six-component energy equivalence claim
metrics.aggregate: fixed denominator5, per-case and worst/mean; do not transfer existing node U error to new4Q scores

small_query_scope.selection: one actual scan_face_conformity per CAD max_records8; select_cells_and_faces max_cells32/max_faces8, lexicographic corner-ID face order plus original cell rows; no result-driven selection
small_query_scope.interior: two strictly interior barycentrics [0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4] and [0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1] per selected cell, <=64 occurrences/CAD
small_query_scope.shared_faces: two canonical-face barycentrics [1/3,1/3,1/3] and [0.2,0.3,0.5], map sorted shared corner IDs onto both local cells; <=16 shared physical points/32 sided occurrences/CAD
small_query_scope.C0: record physical-position and U trace differences; no GT needed to establish same conforming6-node quadratic face trace
small_query_scope.normal_derivative: report (G_left-G_right) n using one common unit normal from canonical shared P2 surface tangents; one-sided derivatives, expected nonzero for C0 FE, never a C1 failure gate
small_query_scope.inverse: reuse bounded GeometryLocator.locate on selected<=32 cells for the <=96 occurrences, no oracle barycentrics supplied to inverse; inherited LocatorConfig bounds unchanged
small_query_scope.scope_limit: All-cell barycentric/native queries plus bounded physical-point inversion; no claim of a fast unlabelled-point global whole-CAD locator or globally unique inverse.

acceptance.capability_complete: all5 all4Q predicted+GT-proxy metrics finite and covered, exact row/element identities, positive accepted weights, FP64 mm units, all5 prelabel barrier, no forbidden reads
acceptance.new_small_geometry: only the actual selected query validity/inverse checks; failure reported without repair/substitution; no old8K guards repeated
acceptance.accuracy: Report fixed fullQ proxy accuracy separately from native API/coverage acceptance; no source strain accuracy or final solver winner inferred.
acceptance.trace_tolerance_definitions: max physical position trace gap / characteristic L <=1e-9; max U trace gap / max(1mm,max absolute traceU) <=1e-9; inverse/direct U replay uses same1mm floor with1e-7 tolerance. These are numerical replay gates, not GT accuracy denominators.
acceptance.zero_reference: A zero GT proxy energy yields null relative score plus exact zero flag and absolute error; this does not mean missing coverage.

read_policy.accepted_cache_members: vertices_mm,cells10,grid_node_ids,ctetra_element_ids; accepted gradients/weights. Reuse load_input target-free reader if necessary, no scientific old stage entrypoint.

budget.one_fixed_attempt: No new solve/recovery/tuning/mesh fallback. Actual first frozen run is acceptance; no resource or science preflight. Failure/resume wall counts without reset.
budget.costs: Cached continuous query/input/reference/persistence costs measured separately; full service cost composes original zero physics plus actual continuous query costs, not a fresh combined cold measurement. Never splice newer fine/coarse costs.
budget.ledger: Compact case/phase/elapsed journal about60s or completeCAD/barrier/failure; deterministic selectors+cursor replace unbounded prefixes. Final exit always accounts wall, failed attempts and unfinished work.

reuse_API.topology_and_inverse: same scan_face_conformity/select_cells_and_faces/GeometryLocator.locate; no synthetic_fixture or old101479 evaluator
reuse_API.target_free_cache: geobc.elastic_pilot_data.load_input; metadata contract/stat helpers from elastic_crosscad; direct selective accepted cache reads may avoid unused RBE/load data
reuse_API.engineering_note: Do not reuse corner-P1 gradient_supervision.cell_tensor_strain or call old bounded diagnostic scientific entrypoints

costs.query_cost_scope: all original4Q field persistence and fixed bounded inverse/face diagnostics; not single-point latency

native_field_math.U: U_cq,a=sum_i N_i(Lq) U_cell_i,a; all signed10 P2 weights, no P1 corner surrogate
native_field_math.X: X_cq=sum_i N_i(Lq) X_cell_i, curved physical TET10 geometry
native_field_math.gradient: G_cq,a,b=sum_i U_cell_i,a * accepted_dN_dX_cq,i,b; no new operator assembly or solve
native_field_math.additional_queries: J_c,r=sum_i X_i,c dN_i/dr_r; solve J^T grad_X_N=grad_r_N in FP64, then same full10 U/G. No normalized-coordinate derivative.

science_recipe.GT_proxy: Only original canonical nodal displacement member, after all five candidate predictions commit. Apply same10 P2 basis and physical gradients to GT U. Derived U/G/engineering-strain are node-derived P2 proxies, never source-solver strain GT, constitutive recovery or continuum validation.

candidate_persistence_before_GT.resume: Never recompute committed candidate queries or repeat committed source GT U reads; use owned per-case derived proxy/metric cache. Uncommitted GT read remains explicit blocking failure.

metrics.primary: Each CAD full4Q positive-volume-weighted U-vector/G-Frobenius/engineering6 relativeL2, reference energy zero => null, no epsilon-manufactured score
metrics.absolute: weighted U-vector RMS mm and maximum vector error mm; G-Frobenius and strain6 RMS/max dimensionless
metrics.physical_strain_tensor: Also report symmetric3x3 Frobenius proxy error; engineering6 norm weights [1,1,1,0.5,0.5,0.5], not a six-component energy equivalence claim
metrics.aggregate: fixed denominator5, per-case and worst/mean; do not transfer existing node U error to new4Q scores

small_query_scope.selection: one actual scan_face_conformity per CAD max_records8; select_cells_and_faces max_cells32/max_faces8, lexicographic corner-ID face order plus original cell rows; no result-driven selection
small_query_scope.interior: two strictly interior barycentrics [0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4] and [0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1] per selected cell, <=64 occurrences/CAD
small_query_scope.shared_faces: two canonical-face barycentrics [1/3,1/3,1/3] and [0.2,0.3,0.5], map sorted shared corner IDs onto both local cells; <=16 shared physical points/32 sided occurrences/CAD
small_query_scope.C0: record physical-position and U trace differences; no GT needed to establish same conforming6-node quadratic face trace
small_query_scope.normal_derivative: report (G_left-G_right) n using one common unit normal from canonical shared P2 surface tangents; one-sided derivatives, expected nonzero for C0 FE, never a C1 failure gate
small_query_scope.inverse: reuse bounded GeometryLocator.locate on selected<=32 cells for the <=96 occurrences, no oracle barycentrics supplied to inverse; inherited LocatorConfig bounds unchanged
small_query_scope.scope_limit: All-cell barycentric/native queries plus bounded physical-point inversion; no claim of a fast unlabelled-point global whole-CAD locator or globally unique inverse.

acceptance.capability_complete: all5 all4Q predicted+GT-proxy metrics finite and covered, exact row/element identities, positive accepted weights, FP64 mm units, all5 prelabel barrier, no forbidden reads
acceptance.new_small_geometry: only the actual selected query validity/inverse checks; failure reported without repair/substitution; no old8K guards repeated
acceptance.accuracy: Report fixed fullQ proxy accuracy separately from native API/coverage acceptance; no source strain accuracy or final solver winner inferred.
acceptance.trace_tolerance_definitions: max physical position trace gap / characteristic L <=1e-9; max U trace gap / max(1mm,max absolute traceU) <=1e-9; inverse/direct U replay uses same1mm floor with1e-7 tolerance. These are numerical replay gates, not GT accuracy denominators.
acceptance.zero_reference: A zero GT proxy energy yields null relative score plus exact zero flag and absolute error; this does not mean missing coverage.

read_policy.accepted_cache_members: vertices_mm,cells10,grid_node_ids,ctetra_element_ids; accepted gradients/weights. Reuse load_input target-free reader if necessary, no scientific old stage entrypoint.

budget.one_fixed_attempt: No new solve/recovery/tuning/mesh fallback. Actual first frozen run is acceptance; no resource or science preflight. Failure/resume wall counts without reset.
budget.costs: Cached continuous query/input/reference/persistence costs measured separately; full service cost composes original zero physics plus actual continuous query costs, not a fresh combined cold measurement. Never splice newer fine/coarse costs.
budget.ledger: Compact case/phase/elapsed journal about60s or completeCAD/barrier/failure; deterministic selectors+cursor replace unbounded prefixes. Final exit always accounts wall, failed attempts and unfinished work.

reuse_API.topology_and_inverse: same scan_face_conformity/select_cells_and_faces/GeometryLocator.locate; no synthetic_fixture or old101479 evaluator
reuse_API.target_free_cache: geobc.elastic_pilot_data.load_input; metadata contract/stat helpers from elastic_crosscad; direct selective accepted cache reads may avoid unused RBE/load data
reuse_API.engineering_note: Do not reuse corner-P1 gradient_supervision.cell_tensor_strain or call old bounded diagnostic scientific entrypoints
